headline: Integrate with diverse range of devices and protocols
intro_headline: Make the surrounding systems work together.
problem: Lighting, tracking and control systems need to talk to the visuals.
how_disguise_helps: Connect devices and data through Designer’s APIs, plugins and protocols.
demo_instructions: Explore a connection. Try a control input.
result: Choose OSC to advance a cue, DMX to change the simulated light level, or HTTP to update a data graphic. No external device is connected.
